Subject: Cohort sync: short demo + Q&A — pick your best window

Hi all —

Thanks for your interest in a compact group demo covering Redwood Inference’s serving and cost/playbook patterns. We want to keep this to 30 minutes (20 min demo + 10 min Q&A) and make sure the slots work across your teams.

Quick ask: can each org indicate up to two preferred windows from the matrix attached? I’ve included a simple timezone matrix (cohort_timezone_matrix.csv) — please add your preferred slot and your locale.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- 2027-07-13 08:00–08:30 (PDT) — early APAC-friendly
- 2027-07-13 11:00–11:30 (PDT) — friendly for US West / Europe late morning
- 2027-07-14 17:00–17:30 (PDT) — US East / Europe evening option

Agenda (attached 30min_demo_agenda.pdf):
- 0–5m   Quick intros & goals
- 5–25m Live walkthrough (model catalog, routing, and the Optimize toolkit)
- 25–30m Q&A + next steps (pilot / eval plan)

If any organization needs an internal-only follow-up (security checklist or private deployment discussion), flag that in the spreadsheet and we’ll schedule a separate deep-dive.

Thanks — looking forward to getting everyone aligned.

—Aditya
